subject: general
question: Due to ________ phenomena, when light is passed through suspended particles in a medium, some portion of light is absorbed and emitted in all directions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**scattering of light**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When white light from the sun enters the earth's atmosphere, the light gets scattered i.e. the light spreads in all directions by dust particle, free water molecule, and molecules of gases present in the atmosphere. This is called the** scattering of light.**
 
• During the scattering of light, some of the light is absorbed and the rest is scattered.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39290ae6cf2b8eb1aed2ba4b59c06eac02517b7cad4a64df14e6d3efa4e8e8a6.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When white light passes through the glass prism it splits into the seven constituent colors, this phenomenon is called **dispersion of light.**
 
• When a ray of light reaches a smooth polished surface it bounces back, it is called** reflection of light.**
 
• The bending of light as it passes from one substance to another, it is called **refraction of light.**
